about: Unit tests that may skip, each with what it needs. Scripts/ci/unit-skips.py fails a run in which any other test skips, and hosted CI also fails when a test listed here runs or is gone. Variables reach the test host with a TEST_RUNNER_ prefix on xcodebuild.

groups.reason: Calls Anthropic's API with a key the unit job does not hold (TEST_RUNNER_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Run by hand after changing the Anthropic engine.
Calls OpenRouter's transcription API with a key the unit job does not hold (TEST_RUNNER_OPENROUTER_API_KEY). Run by hand after changing server word times.
Sends requests on the developer's signed-in ChatGPT plan (TEST_RUNNER_LOKALBOT_CHATGPT_PLAN_LIVE=1). Run by hand after changing the plan relay.
Runs the developer's signed-in Claude Code on its plan (TEST_RUNNER_LOKALBOT_CLAUDE_PLAN_LIVE=1). Run by hand after changing the Claude plan engine.
Needs the downloaded autocomplete model (LOKALBOT_COTYPING_TEST_MODEL names the GGUF); unit runs never download models. Run for a llama.cpp or autocomplete runtime change.

Needs a downloaded candidate autocomplete model (LOKALBOT_CANDIDATE_TEST_MODEL). Run when comparing a candidate model's native decoding with the shipped path; LOKALBOT_TEST_LEGACY_HEALING=1 runs the prefix-path check on the old decoder, where it must fail.
Latency benchmark over a downloaded GGUF (LOKALBOT_COTYPING_LATENCY_MODEL, with _CASES, _LIBRARY and _OUT). A measurement, run by hand.
Needs cached Qwen3-ASR weights (LOKALBOT_QWEN_TEST_MODEL_DIR, and LOKALBOT_QWEN_TEST_REFERENCE for upgrade parity). Run for a speech runtime update.
Needs the downloaded Qwen3 forced aligner (LOKALBOT_QWEN_ALIGNER_TEST_DIR). Run for an aligner or MLX update.
Needs the verified Nemotron v2 model folder (LOKALBOT_NEMOTRON_TEST_MODEL_DIR). Run for a diarization runtime update.
Needs the prepared public diarization benchmark folder (TEST_RUNNER_NEMOTRON_BENCH_ROOT). Run for a diarization runtime update.
Memory measurement on a copy of the Nemotron diarization folder (LOKALBOT_NEMOTRON_MODEL_DIR). A measurement, run by hand.
Needs the Files text model and projector (LOKALBOT_MEDIA_EMBEDDER_MODELS). Run for every llama.cpp update: it guards FileMediaEmbedder.vectorVersion.
Needs Granite speech weights and a public-audio reference manifest (LOKALBOT_GRANITE5_REFERENCE). Run for a Granite runtime update.
Needs a local sherpa-onnx Fun-ASR model and a public or synthetic speech WAV. Run for a Fun-ASR runtime update.
Needs a fixture library that holds the real embedding model (LOKALBOT_EMBEDDING_FIXTURE). Run for an embedding model or index change.
Timings over a copy of a real library database (LOKALBOT_PERF_DB). A measurement on private data, run by hand.
Day digest benchmark (LOKALBOT_DIGEST_BENCH=1 and its variables; Benchmarks/DayDigest/run.sh sets them). A measurement, run by hand.
Replays copied meeting folders through the action-ownership rules (LOKALBOT_OWNERSHIP_AUDIT). Private data, run by hand.
Replays saved transcripts through the integrity checks (LOKALBOT_INTEGRITY_REPLAY). Private data, run by hand.
Meeting-notes replays over a local manifest (LOKALBOT_NOTES_PLAN_MANIFEST, LOKALBOT_NOTES_REPLAY_MANIFEST). Private data and a local model, run by hand.
Replays call-voice naming on saved meetings (LOKALBOT_SPEAKER_REPLAY_MANIFEST). Private data, run by hand.
Echo cancellation on a real meeting folder (LOKALBOT_AEC_FIXTURE, LOKALBOT_AEC_OUTPUT). Private audio, run by hand.
Replays a private local Granite runtime session (LOKALBOT_GRANITE_REPLAY_MANIFEST). Run by hand.
Needs a large seeded library (LOKALBOT_SCALE_LIBRARY). The nightly Scale and concurrency job builds one and runs these.
Records real model answers through OpenRouter (LOKALBOT_RECORD_MODELS=1). Only the nightly Model drift job runs it.
Checks a freshly installed Agent Mode runtime against the manifest (LOKALBOT_PINNED_RUNTIME_TREE). Run when the runtime pins change.
Needs Agent Mode's runtime installed on the Mac; hosted runners do not have it. Runs on a Mac where Agent Mode was enabled once.
Creates a key in the login Keychain (LOKALBOT_RUN_KEYCHAIN_TESTS=1), which can prompt on screen. Run by hand after changing how the encryption key is chosen.

No scripted browser trace is committed yet. Recording one (Scripts/record-capture/run.sh chrome|safari) opens a browser on a desktop where a Debug build holds Accessibility and Screen Recording, which hosted runners cannot grant. Take this entry off the list with the first committed scripted-*.json trace.
